name: burn_mean_30d
label: Mean share of miner emission burned
price_link: enters the emission gate together with the price
notes: Chain value MinerBurned at the samples where it is a measurement: the subnet has paid emissions and some UID holds incentive. Elsewhere the chain stores 0 by default, which is not a burn of zero. Missing if the window has no such sample.

name: burn_time_share_ge50_30d
label: Share of the window with at least half of miner emission burned
price_link: enters the emission gate together with the price
notes: Same samples as burn_mean_30d.

name: burn_mean_lag30

notes: As burn_mean_30d.

name: burn_time_share_ge50_lag30

notes: As burn_mean_30d.

name: miners_paid_hotkeys_30d
label: Miner hotkeys that were paid

name: miners_paid_coldkeys_30d

name: miner_paid_days_30d
label: Days on which at least one miner was paid

name: miner_hhi_coldkey_30d
label: Concentration of miner pay across wallets (Herfindahl index)
notes: A wallet's share is its incentive summed over the window divided by all incentive paid to miners. Missing if nobody was paid.

name: miner_top1_share_30d
label: Share of miner pay earned by the largest wallet

name: miners_ip_coverage_30d
label: Share of paid hotkeys that publish an IP address

name: miners_distinct_ips_30d
label: Distinct IP addresses of paid miners
notes: Reported only if at least half of the paid hotkeys publish an address; otherwise missing.

name: miners_paid_hotkeys_lag30
label: Miner hotkeys that were paid, lagged window

name: miners_paid_coldkeys_lag30
label: Miner wallets that were paid, lagged window

name: miner_paid_days_lag30
label: Days on which at least one miner was paid, lagged window

name: miner_hhi_coldkey_lag30

name: miner_top1_share_lag30

name: miners_lineage_clusters_ub_30d
label: Independent miner operators, upper bound
notes: Operators among the wallets that earned at least 0.1% of miner pay. Wallets are one operator when the same address, not an exchange, paid at least 20% of the registration cost before they registered. Merging on this evidence alone leaves the most operators, hence an upper bound. Smaller wallets are not counted (lineage_untraced_share_30d); owner-linked wallets are left out.

name: miners_lineage_clusters_best_30d
label: Independent miner operators, best estimate
notes: As the upper bound, and wallets on the same miner IP address or paid out of an exchange in one batch are also one operator. Funders with more than 1,500 transfers (exchanges) never merge wallets. Never larger than the upper bound.

name: miner_hhi_lineage_best_30d
label: Concentration of miner pay across operators, best estimate
notes: Herfindahl index over operators (best estimate). A wallet too small to be traced stands alone; owner-linked wallets are left out. Missing if every paid wallet is owner-linked.

name: owner_linked_incentive_share_30d
label: Share of miner pay earned by wallets that exchanged TAO with the subnet owner
notes: The owner is every key that owned the subnet since the current project started (a team that moved to a new wallet is the same team). The newest 600 transfers of each key in either direction are searched. Owner-linked wallets are left out of the operator counts.

name: miners_unattrib_share_30d
label: Share of miner pay whose operator cannot be told (funded from exchanges only)
notes: Traced wallets that stand alone and whose only funders are exchanges: nothing links them, and nothing shows them to be independent.

name: lineage_untraced_share_30d
label: Share of miner pay earned by wallets too small to be traced
notes: Wallets below 0.1% of miner pay each.

name: miners_active_now
label: Miners with incentive above zero at T

name: owner_buy_tao_30d
label: TAO the owner spent buying its own alpha
price_link: mechanical (flow): a purchase through the pool raises the price in the same window
notes: A trade counts for the wallet that owned the subnet at the time: where the owner key changed inside the window, the earlier key's trades count up to the change and the later key's from then on.

name: owner_sell_tao_30d
label: TAO the owner received selling its own alpha
price_link: mechanical (flow): a purchase through the pool raises the price in the same window
notes: A trade counts for the wallet that owned the subnet at the time: where the owner key changed inside the window, the earlier key's trades count up to the change and the later key's from then on.

name: owner_net_buy_tao_30d
label: Owner's net purchases of its own alpha
price_link: mechanical (flow): a purchase through the pool raises the price in the same window
notes: Transfers dropped; moves between validators netted out. A trade counts for the wallet that owned the subnet at the time: where the owner key changed inside the window, the earlier key's trades count up to the change and the later key's from then on.

name: owner_cut_sold_ratio_30d
label: Alpha sold by the owner relative to the owner cut it received
price_link: mechanical (flow): a purchase through the pool raises the price in the same window
notes: Can exceed 1. The owner cut is 18% of the subnet's alpha emission, counted from the first emission block. Missing if no owner cut was received.

name: owner_net_buy_tao_lag30
label: Owner's net purchases of its own alpha, lagged window
notes: As owner_net_buy_tao_30d.

name: owner_bought_any_90d

price_link: mechanical (flow): a purchase through the pool raises the price in the same window

name: tao_emission_on_share_30d

name: emission_flag_on_share_30d
label: Share of the window with the emission flag switched on
price_link: mechanical (gate): the TAO injected rises steeply with price x (1 - burn); it is zero when the flag is off, the burn is 100% or emissions have not started

notes: As tao_emission_on_share_30d.
